mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and retail sales (RSAFS > 440000) indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the HOUST and RSAFS thresholds, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) reflects strong manufacturing activity, signaling sustained economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment gain exceeding 140,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 140000) indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 140000, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) and subdued inflation (CPIAUCSL < 238) indicate a stable monetary environment conducive to equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL thresholds, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During housing market booms (HOUST > 1100), strong residential construction activity drives consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production growth (INDPRO < 100) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.
